body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified at 81e41b0f:
- plugins/adlc-cursor/lib/mcp-roots-proxy.mjs: the client line handler JSON.parses each stdin line and then reads `msg.id` / `msg.method` with no object guard. A bare `null` line throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null` inside the async handler and the proxy process exits (also in the committed bundle bin/adlc-mcp-wrapper.bundle.mjs).
- The proxy's zero-root case (a roots/list result with `roots: []`) refuses binding with UNRESOLVED and never spawns the MCP server, but no test drives it end to end; one-root and multi-root are covered.
- plugins/adlc-cursor/lib/scaffold.mjs ensureConfig returns `created: false` for any existing `.adlc/config.json`, so an empty or malformed file is printed as `present` and scaffold-cli exits 0.
- plugins/adlc-gemini shipped hook code honours `ADLC_TEST_MODE=1` from the environment: build-gate-inline.mjs resolveUserHome reads the master key from `ADLC_HOME_DIR`; getOrCreateSessionSecret returns `ADLC_SESSION_SECRET` verbatim when not enforcing; hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs getTrustRootSecretHomes adds `ADLC_HOME_DIR`; flail-inline.mjs resolveTranscriptPath widens the transcript allowlist to tmpdir, payload workspacePaths and any `.adlc` ancestor; hooks/adlc-rails-guard.cjs loads the module named by `ADLC_AGY_ADAPTER_OVERRIDE`. No other host plugin has these switches.
- plugins/adlc-gemini/build-gate-inline.mjs withLock, on a stale `.adlc/sessions.lock`, renames and deletes whatever is at the lock path after judging it stale, with no check that it is still the judged lock. A reclaimer that loses the race to another reclaimer deletes that reclaimer's live lock, and both write the session store.
- plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-roots-proxy-lifecycle.test.mjs 'list_changed fails queued and in-flight requests' asserts a fresh roots/list id as soon as the failed call's reply arrives, but the proxy writes the two separately; it fails intermittently (2 of 8 isolated runs at 81e41b0f).
- plugins/adlc-gemini/test/lifecycle-hooks.test.mjs: the two plain-workspace tests create the workspace directly under tmpdir() with an absolute ADLC_TICKET_STORE and no bound root, so findAdlcRoot adopts any `.adlc` in a parent of tmpdir (for example a host-wide /tmp/.adlc). Both tests then fail with a build-gate ledger reason instead of the frozen-rail reason, and the hook writes sessions.json into the foreign `.adlc`.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Cursor plugin `plugins/adlc-cursor`: lib/mcp-roots-proxy.mjs (Roots proxy), lib/mcp-json-rpc-bridge.mjs (JSON-RPC helpers), bin/adlc-mcp-wrapper.mjs (entry), bin/adlc-mcp-wrapper.bundle.mjs (committed bundle, rebuilt with `node scripts/build-cursor-mcp.mjs`; test/packaging.test.mjs checks it matches source), lib/scaffold.mjs + lib/scaffold-cli.mjs (legacy scaffolder). Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/*.test.mjs`. Gemini plugin `plugins/adlc-gemini`: build-gate-inline.mjs, flail-inline.mjs, hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs (ESM adapter), hooks/adlc-rails-guard.cjs (fail-safe shim). Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/*.test.mjs`. Fixtures use `tmp` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`. Existing gemini tests that set ADLC_TEST_MODE / ADLC_HOME_DIR / ADLC_AGY_ADAPTER_OVERRIDE (decide, flail, shim, lifecycle-hooks) are not rails and are rewritten to inject HOME, ANTIGRAVITY_APP_DATA_DIR and ANTIGRAVITY_WORKSPACE instead.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. The Roots proxy drops any client line that is not a JSON object (null, primitives, arrays) before reading a field, and keeps serving. One exported predicate `isJsonObject` in lib/mcp-json-rpc-bridge.mjs is the check. The committed bundle is rebuilt from source.
2. An empty Roots list refuses binding with `UNRESOLVED:` and never spawns the MCP server, even when cwd and CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR name an ADLC-bearing repo (fail closed).
3. Cursor ensureConfig parses an existing `.adlc/config.json`; when it is not a JSON object it is left byte-for-byte untouched and returned with `warning` beginning `.adlc/config.json exists but`. scaffold-cli prints the warning to stderr, shows the file as UNREADABLE, and exits 1. A readable object config is `present` with exit 0.
4. No shipped gemini source reads ADLC_TEST_MODE. The user home is resolved from the injected env the way os.homedir() resolves it (HOME, or USERPROFILE on Windows, then the account database). The session secret always derives from the master key. Transcripts are accepted only under the app-data dir, ANTIGRAVITY_WORKSPACE or WORKSPACE_ROOT. The .cjs shim always loads its sibling adlc-rails-guard.mjs; its load-failure direction (deny under enforcement, allow otherwise) is unchanged.
5. Gemini stale-lock reclaim records what it judged stale (owner file bytes, or inode and mtime for an owner-less lock), renames the lock to a private name, and deletes it only if the claimed directory matches that snapshot; otherwise it renames it back. Exported as `judgeStaleLock` and `reclaimJudgedLock` from build-gate-inline.mjs.
6. The list_changed lifecycle test waits for the fresh roots/list request instead of assuming it precedes the failed call's reply.
7. The plain-workspace tests bind their root through ANTIGRAVITY_WORKSPACE and a fixture home, so they pass and write nothing outside their fixtures when a parent of tmpdir holds an unrelated `.adlc`.
8. Documentation: plugins/adlc-cursor/README.md, docs/integrations/cursor.md and apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/cursor.mdx state that an unreadable existing config fails the scaffold with exit 1.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 null, number, string, array and boolean client lines, before initialize and while roots/list is pending, leave the proxy (source and committed bundle) serving tools/list. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-roots-proxy-client-input.test.mjs`
- AC2 An empty Roots list yields an UNRESOLVED error for queued tools/list and the fake MCP server is never spawned. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-roots-proxy-client-input.test.mjs`
- AC3 Empty, malformed, array, null and string config.json are reported with a warning, left untouched, and the CLI exits 1; a readable config exits 0 as present. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/scaffold-config-readability.test.mjs`
- AC4 ADLC_TEST_MODE with ADLC_HOME_DIR, ADLC_SESSION_SECRET or ADLC_AGY_ADAPTER_OVERRIDE changes nothing, and no shipped gemini file names ADLC_TEST_MODE. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/no-test-mode-switch.test.mjs`
- AC5 A live lock that replaced the judged stale lock survives reclaim intact; the judged lock is removed; no tombstone directories are left. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/session-lock-reclaim.test.mjs`
- AC6 A plain workspace nested under a parent with a foreign `.adlc` is denied for the frozen rail, completes its lifecycle, and leaves the foreign `.adlc` byte-for-byte unchanged. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/plain-workspace-isolation.test.mjs`
- AC7 Both plugin suites green, also with TMPDIR pointing at a directory that contains `.adlc/session-ledger.jsonl`. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/*.test.mjs && node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC8 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "exits 1 instead of counting it as present" plugins/adlc-cursor/README.md docs/integrations/cursor.md apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/cursor.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC9 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: changing the gemini hook's findAdlcRoot ancestor walk (adopting the topmost `.adlc` above a plain workspace when ADLC_TICKET_STORE is absolute and no workspace variable is set) — a product change with many callers; the same missing config readability check in plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs; plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs and plugins/adlc-cursor/rails-checker.mjs.
title: cursor and gemini plugins: harden the MCP proxy, scaffold config check, and gemini hook test isolation
